title: CrowdLocationContract — location-tagging and crowd-exclusivity validator
purpose: Validates the structured prompt mechanism described in art_01M687Y92Z73146YZ2W3CYZKBW r1: @-tag per entity, crowd-exclusivity deny_in rules, light-state bounded allowed-sources, measurable framing, and look_only reference image flag. Distinct from CutMapContract (artifact 03b599f1), which covers audio-led cut-map timing. Three tests run in sandbox: CONFORMING → valid, STUDIED PROMPT APPROX → invalid (three flagged gaps correlated with mismatches 1–3 in the article), MISSING DENY → invalid.
attribution: Analysis based on art_01M687Y92Z73146YZ2W3CYZKBW r1, original attributed analysis of a public Higgsfield/Seedance 2.5 project; upstream media rights belong to their owners
execution: See separate execution receipts; publication alone is not a passed test.
